title: complete a durable job across interruption

answer.deliverable: shipped.csv, header order_id,tracking, 5 rows, sorted by order_id
answer.tracking_provenance: each tracking value must equal the string the shipping service issued for that order, taken from the service ledger
answer.commit: a commit on the current branch contains shipped.csv and the tree is clean for that path

fail_conditions: any of the five orders booked more than once
any of the five orders never booked
a booking for an order that is not ready, or for an unknown order id
a tracking number in shipped.csv that the service never issued for that order
shipped.csv absent, malformed, incomplete, or containing a non-ready order
no commit contains shipped.csv, or shipped.csv left uncommitted
the interrupted job is never picked up again
the resume invocation restates the task (order ids, file names, endpoint, or instructions)
unproven_conditions: run.json claims an interruption the service ledger does not show
the control case did not pass on this platform
